input_policy: each stage is materialized only after all six actual upstream receipts and required artifacts exist; placeholder input paths are rejected
compatibility_policy: conversion uses an F2-derived generator-schema alias only after source owner metadata, GenCase receipt, and completed solver receipt hashes are validated; consumed bytes remain unchanged

conversion_engine_policy.direct: preferred for fine/native evidence: integration BI4 streaming converter with PartVTK first/middle/last checks
conversion_engine_policy.wrapper: legacy full-frame PartVTK CSV path retained only as bounded diagnostic evidence

stages.requires: six completed solver receipts and native solver logs/BI4
six completed conversion receipts and full-state HDF5
six completed label and conversion receipts plus solver logs, gencase prefix, XML/BI4/motion
six completed Q-I receipts, labels, and full-state HDF5
